name: Anti Stress DuoRoll Comfort
description: Dual-comfort roll packed mattress offering reversible sides for seasonal preference.

faqs.question: Can I flip this mattress?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is designed with two comfort profiles on opposite sides.

faqs.question: How long does expansion take after unboxing?
faqs.answer: Most units expand within 24 to 48 hours.
